verdict_reason: Logic is correct (unknown roles are left to AddressRoleNames, at most one group allowed, violation on roles) and tested, but its violation-reporting block is copied in ReceivingRolesInTheUnitedKingdomValidator.

todos.issue: The 'report a class-level violation on one named property' block is written twice in this PR: RolesHeldTogetherValidator.java:15-19 (addPropertyNode("roles")) and ReceivingRolesInTheUnitedKingdomValidator.java:19-23 (addPropertyNode("countryCode")), identical apart from the property name.
todos.fix: Must: one helper owns re-pointing a class-level constraint violation at a property, and both validators call it. One way: a package-private static reportOn(ConstraintValidatorContext context, String property) returning false, in a small shared class in the address package, used by both isValid methods.
